name: decision_router
description: Measures adaptive model-ladder suggestions without changing any request or route.

permissions.name: env.suggest
permissions.description: Publish optional costed suggestions in advise mode without changing routes

permissions.name: env.model_capabilities
permissions.description: Read pricing declared for this provider's ladder models

permissions.name: env.plugin_config
permissions.description: Read the operator's shadow-mode model ladder and signal thresholds

permissions.name: env.http_request
permissions.description: Ask the approved System One endpoint for an optional closed-set shadow classification

permissions.name: env.credential_get
permissions.description: Read the separately bound API key when bearer authentication is enabled

permissions.name: env.state_get
permissions.description: Read this conversation's shadow measurement state

permissions.name: env.state_set
permissions.description: Remember shadow measurements across turns and Torana restarts

permissions.name: env.emit_metric
permissions.description: Record possible suggestions and value-free fallback outcomes

permissions.name: env.log
permissions.description: Report value-free fallback reasons without prompts, responses, or credentials

permissions.name: env.meta_get
permissions.description: Find this request's shadow-state key after the response

permissions.name: env.meta_set
permissions.description: Carry this request's shadow-state key to the after-response hook

credentials.description: Bearer token for an authenticated System One endpoint
